name: Participation Active Youth Policies
content: Note: the following case study is a stub. Please help us complete it.Problems and PurposePartecipActively is a participatory path developed by the Municipality of Galatina and facilitated by Città Fertile. It promotes a network of contacts that gravitate around urban spaces, to implement and solicit ideas and actions aimed at young people, so that they are activators of participation.Exchanges of ideas, collaboration networks, listening to experiences and projects for the development of urban spaces. In the awareness that new technologies and the media have in fact changed the methods and times of democratic participation and representation, no longer just vertical, within traditional political parties and trade unions, but horizontal, widespread and informal, with support groups for campaigns and causes, along non-traditional and immediate communication channels. PartecipAttivaMente is an event in the making. While taking place in a defined physical place, it uses these same digital channels, available to everyone.Background History and ContextOrganizing, Supporting, and Funding EntitiesParticipant Recruitment and SelectionMethods and Tools UsedWhat Went On: Process, Interaction, and ParticipationInfluence, Outcomes, and EffectsAnalysis and Lessons LearnedSee AlsoReferencesExternal Linkshttp://www.partecipattività.org/Notes
